steps.code: pip install mem0ai · npm install mem0ai

steps.zh: 在你的进程里实例化记忆

steps.en: Before each reply, look up relevant memories
steps.zh: 每次回复前，先查相关记忆

steps.en: Fuses vector similarity, BM25 keyword and entity matches into the top facts
steps.zh: 把向量相似、BM25 关键词和实体匹配融合成 top 事实

steps.en: Chat with your own LLM, then feed the turn back
steps.zh: 照常和你的 LLM 对话，再把这轮发回去

steps.en: One LLM pass extracts facts, embeds them and links entities
steps.zh: 一次 LLM 抽取生成事实，做 embedding 并链接实体

value.en: Your agent remembers the user next session without building the extraction prompts, embedding pipeline, or store yourself
value.zh: 下一个会话你的 agent 就记得这个用户，而不必自己搭抽取 prompt、embedding 管线和存储
